note: Canonical list of org repositories. ROUTER.md in Progress-Memory and scaffolds are generated from this file (scripts/org/scaffold.mjs).

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness
repositories.owns: Product monorepo: App, Gateway, kernel, SDKs, official extensions, upstream registry, deploy, roadmap
rules: Engines are consumed unmodified through seams in upstream/registry.yaml.
Everything ships as an extension; nothing may break when an extension is disabled.
UI uses @neometaharness/ui (Astryx) only.
No business logic in the Tauri Rust shell.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Progress-Memory
rules: Maintain continuity without duplicating canonical specifications.
Update live state only from evidence; tool-call success is not proof of completion.
If machine state and prose disagree, machine state wins until reconciled.
Every handoff ends with one precise next action.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Extensions
repositories.owns: Extension registry index, guidelines, review rubric, templates
rules: Every listed extension declares permissions and a Neo API range.
Third-party extensions run as process extensions unless reviewed.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Skills
repositories.owns: Published skill packs (agentskills.io), skills registry, promotion and eval rules
rules: Promote Skills from validated evidence.
Every Skill has an autonomy ceiling agents cannot silently exceed.
Skill improvement creates a candidate version, runs evaluations, and preserves rollback.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Agent-Registry
repositories.owns: Agent/bot templates, roles, teams, SOUL presets
rules: Templates reference Skills by id and version; they never inline them.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Workflows
rules: A workflow records the evidence that it worked.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Automation
rules: Schedules run on Neo nodes, never on GitHub.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-design-system
repositories.owns: Neo theme on Astryx, tokens, UX patterns, @neometaharness/ui guidance
rules: Astryx first; a Neo component exists only when Astryx has no equivalent.
Every pattern documents light and dark.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Security-Trust
repositories.owns: Threat model, permissions model, extension review, disclosure policy
rules: Never store secrets or private user data.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Docs
rules: Docs describe shipped behaviour; plans live in the product repo.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness.github.io
rules: No commercial production on Pages without approval.

repositories.name: NeoMetaHarness-Data-Analytics
rules: Telemetry is opt-in and documented field by field.

repositories.name: .github
rules: Never add workflows.
